purpose: Evidence gate for whether the sole 5% total-return objective can be supported as a historical, expected, probabilistic, or investable claim. Cash distributions are reconciled only as components of total-return accounting.

gate.name: return_evidence
gate.conclusion: The case does not contain a dated, total-return-consistent and point-in-time reproducible history for the final portfolio. The 5% objective is not an evidenced expected return, probability, floor, or guarantee.

objective_definition.total_return_measurement: Time-weighted return for strategy assessment; MWRR/XIRR additionally required for investor experience with external cash flows. Each eligible settled receipt is counted once, and a later investor-directed cash-use choice cannot create a second return.
objective_definition.cash_accounting_boundary: Settled interest, dividends, ETF distributions and REIT distributions must be reconciled to the total-return series, holder taxes, receipt fees and settlement dates. Cash distributions are not a separate target, selection threshold, or annual success test. An issuer-labelled or economically similar capital-repayment component requires a separate ledger flag and predeclared accounting/tax treatment; it is not labelled investment return.
prohibited_interpretations: historical sleeve return equals final portfolio return
NAV return equals investor market-price return
past return proves future probability or guarantee
cash disposition converts a receipt into an additional return
a capital-repayment-like component is investment return without predeclared treatment

formal_replay_specification.minimum_history: At least five completed calendar years in which every frozen T2/T4 candidate exists, plus rolling five-year observations.
formal_replay_specification.weight_rules: Predeclared point-in-time T2/T4 weights; no hindsight substitutions; target D executes at next valid open.
formal_replay_specification.return_rules: Use a single total-return convention per sleeve and prevent distribution double counting.
required_metrics: TWRR and MWRR/XIRR when external flows exist
distribution, tax and fee reconciliation to prevent double counting
formal_reproducibility_requirements: licensed or otherwise authoritative raw EOD source archive
halts, price limits and delisting data

upgrade_conditions: Freeze a dated cross-asset T2 candidate set, including any direct equities, ETFs, REITs, sovereign/cash tools and substitution rules.
Complete structure-specific item research and independent T3 approval before a candidate enters the replay or risk budget.
Obtain frozen total-return, corporate-action and distribution data for every frozen T2/T4 candidate.
Build B0 and B1 from the same date, valuation and cost convention.
Supply account-specific commissions, taxes, settlement and slippage/capacity assumptions.
Run and archive a reproducible replay with explicit assurance limitations.
Report total-return outcomes and independent verification of distribution accounting.
